    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    ATELIER is built on the conviction that design fluency is a strategic capability — not a matter of taste alone. Every module pairs business-English precision with aesthetic judgment, spatial literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium design leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern interior design — from the foundations of space planning and color theory to AI-powered design tools and smart living.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — client presentations, material selection, budget reviews, project installations — written for international design professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. ATELIER reflects his vision: design fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and creative credibility.

    Designed for the designers, studio leads, and design leaders shaping how the world's spaces feel — ATELIER is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for turning empty rooms into places people actually want to be.
